description: Task State Machine for AdMob implementation. Each task represents one atomic unit of work.

tasks.title: Package installation and initial setup
tasks.spec: react-native-google-mobile-ads package must be installed and configured in app.json/app.config.ts with AdMob App IDs.
acceptance_criteria: app.json or app.config.ts contains react-native-google-mobile-ads plugin config
Android AdMob App ID is configured
iOS AdMob App ID is configured
expo-dev-client is installed (required for custom native modules)

tasks.title: Environment variables setup
tasks.spec: All ad unit IDs from ADMOB-PLAN.md Section 5 must be present in .env.local with Google test IDs.
acceptance_criteria: All ADMOB_* environment variable keys from the plan exist in .env.local
Values are Google official test ad unit IDs
src/ads/adUnitIds.ts reads from environment variables with test ID fallbacks

field_definitions.title: Short descriptive title
field_definitions.spec: What this task must accomplish. Derived from ADMOB-PLAN.md
field_definitions.acceptance_criteria: Array of strings. Each criterion must be programmatically verifiable by checking file contents, grep results, or command output. Vague criteria like 'works correctly' are not allowed.
field_definitions.status: One of: fail (not yet passed), pass (verified by Evaluator), blocked (failed after max retries)
field_definitions.priority: Integer. Lower number = higher priority. Determines execution order.
field_definitions.dependencies: Array of task IDs that must be 'pass' before this task can start
field_definitions.evaluator_feedback: String or null. Evaluator writes specific, actionable feedback here on failure
field_definitions.retry_count: Integer. Incremented each time Generator re-attempts after Evaluator failure. Max 2.

status_transitions.fail -> pass: Only when Evaluator verifies ALL acceptance_criteria
status_transitions.fail -> blocked: After retry_count reaches 2 and Evaluator still fails it
status_transitions.pass -> fail: Never. Once passed, a task stays passed.
status_transitions.blocked -> fail: User intervention can unblock and reset to fail for retry
